text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The holidays are here, but that isn't the
only thing
on our minds. This is also a
crucial time to make
final preparations
for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean Nature should
wear herself
thin. I decide to come up
with a way for her to
relax.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You got this, Nature... You got this,
Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alll right! Trainer, I'll do one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Nice Nature training with such

determination today, I can't bring myself
to tell
her about my R&R plan.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That's a wrap! I was so focused
today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I've got plans after this, so I
better
skedaddle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...I wasn't able to invite her out after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, later that night...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. It's me, Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um... Can you come out for a second?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are. Over here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, I wanted to dress better than
a
tracksuit or school uniform tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's the holidays, right? Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Here. I got this for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing impressive, but... I hope it's
not too
boring either...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the box is a hand-knitted scarf
with a
simple design. Its soft fibers put
my heart at ease.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I had my mom teach me how to knit, so
it should
be pretty sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But I really don't have an eye for design.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want it to be so tacky that you
can't wear
it outside, but I wanted it to
have enough
character to not look lame.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
After thinking for some time... it ended
up having
no pattern or decoration.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry I couldn't make it cute.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Do you really mean that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty plain, you know. The only
thing going
for it is its sturdiness... You
still like it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess my all-nighter paid off, then!
Good, good!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, by the way...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The folks at the shopping district are
having a hot
pot party tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
With each shop bringing their own
ingredients,
the hot pot is guaranteed to
be good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Wanna go?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now we're talking!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It'll be good to see people there and lift
my
spirits before the race too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nice Nature and I enjoy some

delicious hot pot in the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um... So, after this...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah-choo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I would like to say I'm okay, but... it's
pretty cold.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I forgot to bring my coat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The all-nighter might have been pushing
it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No way! I don't wanna waste my courage!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, I went through all the trouble
of getting
permission to leave campus!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's slow down a bit... How about a
walk?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This might be our last opportunity to
take time
and talk like this before the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So... please?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But you'll be cold...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'll borrow it. I shouldn't be
risking
getting sick.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: In exchange, you need to wear the scarf I gave you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod and take the scarf before wrapping
it
around my neck.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it suits you. I sure know what color
looks best
on you, huh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Don't lose it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'll go ahead and borrow that
coat, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwip!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Nice and toastyyy. Thanks a ton.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's really warm... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Nice Nature and I spend a
nice night
together, taking in the festive
atmosphere as we
stroll along.
